verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 10.220
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 10.220

verses.pali: 21. Karajakāyavagga
verses.english: 21. The Body Born of Deeds

verses.pali: Adhammacariyāsutta
verses.english: Unprincipled Conduct

verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then a certain brahmin went up to the Buddha and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena m’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjantī”ti?
verses.english: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell?”

verses.pali: “Adhammacariyāvisamacariyāhetu kho, brāhmaṇa, evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjantī”ti.
verses.english: “Unprincipled and immoral conduct is the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.”

verses.pali: “Ko pana, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena m’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjantī”ti?
verses.english: “But what is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm?”

verses.pali: “Dhammacariyāsamacariyāhetu kho, brāhmaṇa, evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjantī”ti.
verses.english: “Principled and moral conduct is the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.”

verses.pali: “Na kho ahaṁ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṁ ājānāmi.
verses.english: “I don’t understand the detailed meaning of what the worthy Gotama has said in brief.

verses.pali: Sādhu me bhavaṁ gotamo tathā dhammaṁ desetu yathāhaṁ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṁ ājāneyyan”ti.
verses.english: Please, worthy Gotama, teach me this matter so I can understand the detailed meaning.”

verses.pali: “Tena hi, brāhmaṇa, suṇāhi, sādhukaṁ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: “Well then, brahmin, listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bho”ti kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
verses.english: “Yes, worthy sir,” the brahmin replied.

verses.pali: Bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said this:

verses.pali: “Tividhā kho, brāhmaṇa, kāyena adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti;
verses.english: “Brahmin, unprincipled and immoral conduct is threefold by way of body,

verses.pali: catubbidhā vācāya adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti;
verses.english: fourfold by way of speech,

verses.pali: tividhā manasā adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti.
verses.english: and threefold by way of mind.

verses.pali: Kathañca, brāhmaṇa, tividhā kāyena adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti …pe…
verses.english: And how is unprincipled and immoral conduct threefold by way of body? …

verses.pali: evaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, tividhā kāyena adhammacariyā visamacariyā hoti.
verses.english: That’s how unprincipled and immoral conduct is threefold by way of body.

verses.pali: Kathañca, brāhmaṇa, catubbidhā vācāya adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti …pe…
verses.english: And how is unprincipled and immoral conduct fourfold by way of speech? …

verses.pali: evaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, catubbidhā vācāya adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti.
verses.english: That’s how unprincipled and immoral conduct is fourfold by way of speech.

verses.pali: Kathañca, brāhmaṇa, tividhā manasā adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti …pe…
verses.english: And how is unprincipled and immoral conduct threefold by way of mind? …

verses.pali: evaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, tividhā manasā adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti.
verses.english: That’s how unprincipled and immoral conduct is threefold by way of mind.

verses.pali: Evaṁ adhammacariyāvisamacariyāhetu kho, brāhmaṇa, evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjanti.
verses.english: That’s how unprincipled and immoral conduct is the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

verses.pali: Tividhā, brāhmaṇa, kāyena dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti;
verses.english: Principled and moral conduct is threefold by way of body,

verses.pali: catubbidhā vācāya dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti;
verses.english: fourfold by way of speech,

verses.pali: tividhā manasā dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti.
verses.english: and threefold by way of mind.

verses.pali: Kathañca, brāhmaṇa, tividhā kāyena dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti …pe…
verses.english: And how is principled and moral conduct threefold by way of body? …

verses.pali: evaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, tividhā kāyena dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti.
verses.english: That’s how principled and moral conduct is threefold by way of body.

verses.pali: Kathañca, brāhmaṇa, catubbidhā vācāya dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti …pe…
verses.english: And how is principled and moral conduct fourfold by way of speech? …

verses.pali: evaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, catubbidhā vācāya dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti.
verses.english: That’s how principled and moral conduct is fourfold by way of speech.

verses.pali: Kathañca, brāhmaṇa, tividhā manasā dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti …pe…
verses.english: And how is principled and moral conduct threefold by way of mind? …

verses.pali: evaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, tividhā manasā dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti.
verses.english: That’s how principled and moral conduct is threefold by way of mind.

verses.pali: Evaṁ dhammacariyāsamacariyāhetu kho, brāhmaṇa, evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjantī”ti.
verses.english: That’s how principled and moral conduct is the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.”

verses.pali: “Abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama …pe…
verses.english: “Excellent, worthy Gotama! Excellent! …

verses.pali: upāsakaṁ maṁ bhavaṁ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: From this day forth, may the worthy Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”

verses.pali: Dasamaṁ.
Karajakāyavaggo paṭhamo.
